[[File:Kotor2_mining_laser.png|thumb|250px|A heavy mining laser]]
A '''mining laser''' was a laser used by personnel on many mining stations, such as the [[Peragus Mining Facility]]. Miners used them because they doubled as a defensive weapon, and it could be used to drill through rock without setting fuel barrels and other flammable objects ablaze. Many mining [[Droid/Legends|droids]] used this device in their mining operations. Various size existed, from the smaller, pistol-like versions, to the heavier, two-handed ones.<ref name="KOTOR2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>
Larger, less portable models also existed.<ref name="BalP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]''</ref>
